text: Ladysmith Avenue is a residential street located south of Danforth Avenue and east of Greenwood Avenue. It is directly adjacent to a new school and I have heard from residents concerned about the volume and speed of traffic that will use this street when the new school opens. I have polled the street and local residents support the installation of speed humps on Ladysmith Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Ladysmith Avenue, between Danforth Avenue and Mountjoy Avenue 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install three speed humps on Ladysmith Avenue, between Danforth Avenue and Mountjoy Avenue, generally as shown on the attached Drawing No. TC-143, dated April 2023 from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
